items.title: Class 12 date sheet is not out yet
items.summary: We found no CBSE announcement of the 2027 Class 12 date sheet as of 31 Oct 2026. Reports expect it around Oct to Nov, but that is an estimate, not a CBSE notice.

items.title: LOC correction window: 2 to 4 Nov 2026
items.summary: Schools submit the List of Candidates (opened 24 Sep; regular deadline 21 Oct; late fee of Rs 2,000 per candidate till 30 Oct). Ask your school to check your name, subjects and details before the correction window closes. No changes after that.

items.title: Practical exam dates not announced
items.summary: CBSE has not confirmed practical dates. Past years suggest they begin around 1 January, but that is only a trend. Wait for your school's schedule.

items.title: Class 12 sample papers and marking schemes are out
items.summary: CBSE released the Class 12 sample question papers and marking schemes for 2026-27 on 21 Sep 2026. Practise with them under timed conditions.

items.title: 2026-27 syllabus out; pattern and passing marks unchanged
items.summary: The 2026-27 syllabus is on the CBSE website. The exam pattern is the same as last year, and the pass mark is 33% in each subject, as reported.
